title: Fayetteville Climate Action Plan - FAYETTEVILLE, United States of America
description: The goal of the Climate Action Plan is to inform future policies, programs and actions undertaken by the City and to assist the City in its efforts to remain resilient to the anticipated changes in the climate to preserve the quality of life for those who live, work and play in Fayetteville. The Climate Action Plan is made up of two parts: the Energy Action Plan and Nature-based Solutions. The Energy Action Plan is an existing document created by the City and updated in 2024 to better reflect the current goals of the City. The Nature-based Solutions (NBS) document was developed to establish goals and strategies that improve ecosystem resilience in the City.
